File regenerated by running 'python3 generate_build_gn.py'
Requires Bazel 8 or higher to regenerate

NOTE: Multiple Bazel 8 files have a "cpu:ppc" bug, where it should read "cpu:ppc64le"
This causes various toolchain failures of the form:

While resolving toolchains for target @@rules_python+//python:current_py_toolchain
	@@bazel_tools//tools/python:toolchain_type

This requires a one-time edit of two files in the Bazel cache directory to resolve:
	external/rules_python+/python/versions.bzl
	external/rules_python++python+pythons_hub/BUILD.bazel
